messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 1):
"""
Annexure -1 CUSTOMER INFORMATION SHEET/KNOW YOUR POLICY This document provides key information about your policy. You are also advised to go through your policy document. Sl No Title Description (Please refer to applicable Policy Clause Number in next column) Policy Clause Number 1 Name of Insurance Product/Policy XXXXXX 2 Policy number 3 Type of Insurance Product/ Policy  Indemnity (Where insured losses are covered up to the Sum Insured under the policy)  Benefit (Where an Insurance Policy pays a fixed amount under the policy on the occurrence of a covered event)  Both Indemnity and Benefit (where policy has elements of both the above) 4 Sum Insured (Basis) (Along with amount)  Individual Sum Insured -Where each member has a separate sum insured under the policy), or  Floater Sum Insured-Where all members under the policy have a single sum insured limit which may be utilized by any or all members
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What are the two types of sum insured that can be specified in a health insurance policy?","answer":"A policy can have either an Individual Sum Insured, where each member has a separate sum insured, or a Floater Sum Insured, where all members share a single sum insured limit.","facts":["Individual Sum Insured -Where each member has a separate sum insured under the policy","Floater Sum Insured-Where all members under the policy have a single sum insured limit"]},{"question":"What are the two main categories of health insurance products mentioned in the policy sheet?","answer":"The policy can be an Indemnity product, a Benefit product, or a combination of both Indemnity and Benefit.","facts":["Indemnity (Where insured losses are covered up to the Sum Insured under the policy)","Benefit (Where an Insurance Policy pays a fixed amount under the policy on the occurrence of a covered event)","Both Indemnity and Benefit (where policy has elements of both the above)"]}]}
